title: SLA: Scaling Spatial-Language-Action Model via Continual Pre-training
summary: Reliable robotic manipulation requires both semantic understanding and precise control in three-dimensional space. However, vision-language-action (VLA) foundations largely inherit visual representations from 2D vision-language pre-training, while spatial supervision is often introduced only during task-specific adaptation. Developing spatial understanding as a transferable foundation-model capability therefore calls for learning from broader robot experience. We present SLA, a Spatial-Language-Action Model that scales implicit spatial alignment to continual pre-training and maintains it during downstream post-training. Initialized from a pretrained pi05 policy, SLA jointly optimizes action prediction and alignment between intermediate visual embeddings and spatial representations from a frozen 3D perception model. We curate and unify heterogeneous robot datasets to support spatial learning across diverse embodiments, tasks, and scenes. To accommodate this diversity, we introduce feature-dependent gates that adaptively aggregate visual embeddings from multiple VLA layers for spatial supervision. The teacher further exploits partially available depth and camera calibration alongside RGB observations, enabling effective use of heterogeneous geometric annotations. Probabilistic state dropout encourages reliance on visual cues and mitigates overfitting to demonstration trajectories. All auxiliary components are used only during training, allowing direct reuse of pretrained VLA weights and preserving the original inference architecture.
tldr: SLA scales spatial-language-action models by continually pre-training on heterogeneous robot data, using a frozen 3D perception model to supervise visual embeddings via feature-dependent gates and probabilistic state dropout, improving spatial understanding while preserving inference-time architecture.
tldr_zh: SLA 通过持续预训练，利用冻结的3D感知模型监督视觉嵌入，并采用特征相关门控和概率状态丢弃，在异构机器人数据上扩展空间-语言-动作模型，提升空间理解同时保持推理架构不变。
summary_zh: 可靠的机器人操作需要三维空间中的语义理解与精确控制。然而，视觉-语言-动作（VLA）基础模型在很大程度上继承了二维视觉-语言预训练的视觉表征，而空间监督通常仅在任务特定适配阶段才被引入。因此，将空间理解发展为一种可迁移的基础模型能力，需要从更广泛的机器人经验中学习。我们提出了SLA，一种空间-语言-动作模型（Spatial-Language-Action Model），该模型将隐式空间对齐扩展到持续预训练阶段，并在下游后训练期间保持这种对齐。SLA从预训练的pi05策略初始化，联合优化动作预测以及中间视觉嵌入与来自冻结三维感知模型的空间表征之间的对齐。我们整理并统一了异构机器人数据集，以支持跨多种具身形态、任务和场景的空间学习。为适应这种多样性，我们引入了特征依赖门控，自适应地聚合来自多个VLA层的视觉嵌入以进行空间监督。教师模型进一步利用了部分可用的深度信息和相机标定参数，结合RGB观测，从而有效利用异构几何标注。概率性状态丢弃鼓励模型依赖视觉线索，并减轻对演示轨迹的过拟合。所有辅助组件仅在训练期间使用，从而允许直接复用预训练的VLA权重，并保持原有推理架构不变。

title: La-JEPA: Compact Robot Policies with Latent World Modeling
summary: World-action models adapt pretrained video generators, and vision-language-action models build on pretrained vision-language backbones; both tie policy architecture and inference cost to large transformers designed for generation rather than control. It remains unclear how much these generation-oriented choices affect control. In this work, we introduce Latent Action JEPA (La-JEPA), a compact world-action model whose policy transformer is trained from scratch in the feature space of a pretrained V-JEPA 2.1 encoder. Following Fast-WAM, La-JEPA learns to predict future features jointly with actions during training and generates only actions at inference. Among policies without embodied pretraining, La-JEPA achieves state-of-the-art performance in clean and randomized RoboTwin 2.0 scenes and on LIBERO-Plus with correct instructions, while using far fewer parameters than the strongest competing policies. It runs substantially faster than Fast-WAM at comparable performance and outperforms the closest JEPA-based methods, LeapBot-WA and JEPA-WAM, on LIBERO-Plus and RoboTwin 2.0 without their pretrained policy backbones. On four real-robot tasks, its average success is comparable to pi0.5 and above non-embodied-pretrained baselines. Through a design study of the choices behind La-JEPA, we show that JEPA features outperform video VAE latents, most clearly out of distribution, and that training-time future prediction choices significantly impact the policy even when future prediction is skipped at inference. We correct the LIBERO-Plus instructions, as the officially released evaluator corrupts them for most variants, and re-evaluate several strong open baselines. Without a generative pretrained policy backbone, La-JEPA is better and faster than far larger policies, suggesting that robot foundation models may benefit from architectures designed for control rather than inherited from generation.
tldr: La-JEPA introduces a compact world-action model that trains a policy transformer from scratch in the feature space of a pretrained V-JEPA encoder, achieving state-of-the-art performance on robotic manipulation benchmarks with fewer parameters and faster inference than larger models.
tldr_zh: La-JEPA 提出了一种紧凑的世界动作模型，在预训练的 V-JEPA 编码器的特征空间中从头训练策略变换器，在机器人操作基准上以更少的参数和更快的推理速度取得了最先进的性能。
summary_zh: 世界-动作模型适配预训练的视频生成器，而视觉-语言-动作模型则建立在预训练的视觉-语言骨干网络之上；两者都将策略架构和推理成本绑定到为生成而非控制设计的大型Transformer上。这些面向生成的设计选择在多大程度上影响控制性能，目前仍不清楚。在本工作中，我们提出了潜动作JEPA（La-JEPA），一种紧凑的世界-动作模型，其策略Transformer在预训练V-JEPA 2.1编码器的特征空间中从头训练。遵循Fast-WAM的思路，La-JEPA在训练期间联合预测未来特征与动作，推理时仅生成动作。在无具身预训练的策略中，La-JEPA在干净和随机化的RoboTwin 2.0场景以及指令正确的LIBERO-Plus上取得最优性能，同时参数量远少于最强的竞争策略。在相当性能下，其运行速度显著快于Fast-WAM，并且在LIBERO-Plus和RoboTwin 2.0上优于最接近的基于JEPA的方法——LeapBot-WA和JEPA-WAM，且无需其预训练策略主干。在四个真实机器人任务上，其平均成功率与pi0.5相当，并高于无具身预训练的基线。通过对La-JEPA背后设计选择的系统研究，我们证明JEPA特征优于视频VAE潜变量，在分布外场景中尤为明显；同时，训练时的未来预测选择即使推理时跳过未来预测，也会显著影响策略性能。我们修正了LIBERO-Plus的指令，因为官方发布的评估器会损坏大多数变体的指令，并重新评估了多个强开源基线。在无生成式预训练策略主干的情况下，La-JEPA优于且快于远大于自身的策略，这表明机器人基础模型可能受益于为控制而设计而非继承自生成的架构。

title: HITCH: Teaching a Vision-Language Model to Operate a Humanoid through a Whole-Body Harness
summary: Enabling vision-language models (VLMs) to control humanoid robots requires both reliable whole-body interfaces and knowledge of how to use the body that carries over across tasks. We present HITCH (Harness Interfaces To Command Humanoids), a harness in which perception returns the 3D position of any point the VLM selects in its image, and execution turns commands for the pelvis, torso, hands, walking, and gaze into whole-body motion with a learned tracker. We find that both measuring the scene and executing commands accurately raise task success. We then fine-tune a VLM on trajectories in which teacher policies solve five base tasks through HITCH, so that it learns how to operate the humanoid. Without task-specific trajectories, the fine-tuned model completes 51% of SIMPLE episodes and 42.5% of HumanoidArena episodes, and adding five trajectories per SIMPLE task raises its SIMPLE success to 95%. On a real G1, it carries a box and walks to a goal without real training data.
tldr: HITCH presents a harness interface that lets a vision-language model control a humanoid robot by selecting 3D points in images and issuing whole-body commands, with fine-tuning on teacher trajectories enabling cross-task generalization and real-world deployment without real training data.
tldr_zh: HITCH 提出了一种挽具接口，使视觉语言模型能够通过选择图像中的 3D 点和发布全身指令来控制人形机器人，并通过在教师轨迹上进行微调，实现跨任务泛化和无真实训练数据的真实世界部署。
summary_zh: 使视觉-语言模型（VLMs）能够控制人形机器人，既需要可靠的全身接口，也需要掌握跨任务迁移的身体运用知识。我们提出了HITCH（Harness Interfaces To Command Humanoids）——一种操控装置，其中感知模块返回VLM在图像中选定的任意点的三维位置，执行模块则将针对骨盆、躯干、双手、行走和注视的指令，通过一个学习型跟踪器转化为全身运动。我们发现，准确测量场景与准确执行指令均能提升任务成功率。随后，我们在教师策略通过HITCH解决五个基础任务的轨迹上对VLM进行微调，使其学会操作人形机器人。在没有任务特定轨迹的情况下，微调后的模型在SIMPLE的50%情节和HumanoidArena的42.5%情节中完成目标，而在每个SIMPLE任务中增加五条轨迹后，其在SIMPLE中的成功率提升至95%。在真实G1机器人上，该模型在无真实训练数据的情况下，能够搬运箱子并走向目标。

title: AffectiveVLA: Safe and Intent-Aware VLA Control for Human-Humanoid Social Interaction
summary: Social touch interactions, such as handshakes, fist bumps, and hugs, require humanoid robots to infer human intent, generate contact-rich motions, and maintain safe physical contact. We present AffectiveVLA, an intent-gated Vision-Language-Action (VLA) pipeline deployed on a Unitree G1 humanoid with dexterous hands. A lightweight RGB-based model recognizes interaction intent from two onboard cameras and converts it into a language prompt for the VLA policy. Low-confidence predictions suppress motion execution, reducing unintended activations. During physical contact, interaction-specific compliance profiles adjust arm impedance, while an independent voice-triggered mechanism initiates a latched safe-stop procedure. Using VR teleoperation, we collected approximately 1,300 multimodal interaction episodes and fine-tuned four VLA models: GR00T, RLDX-1, Being-H0.5, and UnifoLM-VLA-0. On-robot evaluation identifies GR00T as the best-performing standalone model. Integrating intent recognition increases its macro-F1 score from 0.75 to 0.90, while the intent model achieves a p95 inference latency of 6.27 ms. These results demonstrate that explicit intent gating improves the reliability of VLA-based social interaction without compromising real-time operation.
tldr: AffectiveVLA is an intent-gated Vision-Language-Action pipeline for human-humanoid social touch, integrating lightweight intent recognition, compliance profiles, and a safe-stop mechanism, deployed on a Unitree G1 and fine-tuned with VR teleoperation data.
tldr_zh: AffectiveVLA 是一个面向人形机器人社交接触的意图门控视觉-语言-动作流水线，集成了轻量级意图识别、顺应性控制和安全停止机制，并在 Unitree G1 上部署与验证。
summary_zh: 社交触摸互动，如握手、碰拳和拥抱，要求人形机器人推断人类意图、生成富含接触的运动，并维持安全物理接触。我们提出了AffectiveVLA，一种意图门控的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）流水线，部署在配备灵巧手的Unitree G1人形机器人上。一个轻量级基于RGB的模型从两个板载摄像头识别互动意图，并将其转换为VLA策略的语言提示。低置信度预测会抑制动作执行，从而减少非预期激活。在物理接触过程中，特定于互动类型的依从性配置调节手臂阻抗，同时一个独立的语音触发机制启动锁存的安全停止程序。通过VR遥操作，我们收集了约1，300个多模态互动片段，并微调了四个VLA模型：GR00T、RLDX-1、Being-H0.5和UnifoLM-VLA-0。机器人上的评估表明GR00T是性能最佳的独立模型。整合意图识别将其宏F1分数从0.75提升至0.90，而意图模型的p95推理延迟为6.27毫秒。这些结果表明，显式意图门控在不影响实时操作的前提下，提高了基于VLA的社交互动的可靠性。

title: Concertina: Embodying Manipulation and Cognition in One Diffusion Vision-Language Model
summary:
Most vision-language-action (VLA) policies decouple manipulation from cognition by bolting an external action mechanism onto a vision-language model (VLM)--either quantizing actions into discrete tokens whose errors bear no stable correspondence to physical displacements, or delegating continuous trajectory generation to a separate action expert whose gradients compete with or are blocked from updating the VLM backbone. We argue that manipulation and cognition should instead be embodied in the same model, shifting from a decoupled VLA to an Embodied Vision-Language Model (eVLM). We introduce Concertina, an eVLM that places continuous trajectory representation, blockwise generation, and physical-coordinate supervision directly on the computation and parameter path of a shared diffusion VLM backbone. Each control timestep is encoded as one continuous latent action token in the backbone hidden space, and the shared Transformer reconstructs temporally ordered action blocks via the same corrupt-and-reconstruct operator used for multimodal pretraining. Active action projections account for only 0.21% of parameters in the 4.46B model with zero separate action-generator layers, compared with 16.5%-35.1% dedicated action-expert capacity in representative continuous VLAs. Using our proposed Action Interface Audit, we confirm that cross-time trajectory coupling emerges in the middle and late layers of the shared backbone rather than at the action interfaces. On standard benchmarks, Concertina achieves 98.15% average success on regular LIBERO, 85.9% on the 10,030-task LIBERO-Plus benchmark, and 4.142 average completed chain length on CALVIN ABC-D.
  Code: https://github.com/lose4578/Concertina Hugging Face: https://huggingface.co/collections/Traly/concertina
tldr: Concertina introduces an Embodied Vision-Language Model (eVLM) that unifies manipulation and cognition by encoding continuous trajectories as latent action tokens within a shared diffusion VLM backbone, eliminating separate action generators and achieving strong performance on LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, and CALVIN benchmarks.
tldr_zh: Concertina 提出了一种具身视觉语言模型（eVLM），通过将连续轨迹编码为共享扩散 VLM 主干中的潜在动作令牌，统一了操作与认知，消除了单独的动作生成器，并在 LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus 和 CALVIN 基准上取得了强劲性能。
summary_zh:
大多数视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略通过将外部动作机制附加到视觉-语言模型（VLM）上来实现操作与认知的解耦——要么将动作量化为离散令牌，其误差与物理位移之间缺乏稳定的对应关系，要么将连续轨迹生成委托给独立的动作专家，而后者的梯度与VLM主干更新相互竞争或被阻断。我们认为，操作与认知应内嵌于同一模型中，从解耦式VLA转向具身视觉-语言模型（eVLM）。我们提出Concertina，一种eVLM，将连续轨迹表示、分块生成和物理坐标监督直接置于共享扩散VLM主干的计算与参数路径上。每个控制时间步被编码为主干隐藏空间中的一个连续潜在动作令牌，共享Transformer通过多模态预训练中使用的同一“损坏-重建”算子重建时间有序的动作块。活跃的动作投影仅占4.46B模型中参数的0.21%，且不包含独立的动作生成器层，而代表性的连续VLA中专用动作专家容量占比为16.5%–35.1%。利用我们提出的动作接口审计（Action Interface Audit），我们确认跨时间的轨迹耦合出现在共享主干的中间层和后期层，而非动作接口处。在标准基准测试中，Concertina在常规LIBERO上达到98.15%的平均成功率，在包含10,030个任务的LIBERO-Plus基准上达到85.9%，并在CALVIN ABC-D上实现4.142的平均完成任务链长度。  
代码：https://github.com/lose4578/Concertina Hugging Face：https://huggingface.co/collections/Traly/concertina

title: Spatial-UMI-Dream: Scaling World Action Models with Metric Geometry for UMI Manipulation
summary: The Universal Manipulation Interface (UMI) enables scalable demonstration collection independently of a specific robot. However, its moving, close-range gripper cameras entangle camera and object motion without a stable external view, leaving the metric geometry needed for precise manipulation implicit in RGB. We introduce Spatial-UMI-Dream, a 5B spatial World Action Model (WAM) pretrained on 605 hours of RGB-D UMI data through two-stage training -- world-only adaptation followed by joint world-action learning -- to jointly predict future RGB, fisheye-aligned metric depth, and actions. Stereo-derived depth makes scene scale and spatial relationships explicit within a unified dual-gripper RGB-D representation. Furthermore, evaluating UMI policies requires testing whether UMI's robot-independent demonstration collection translates into policy generalization across robot embodiments, alongside robustness to environmental changes. We introduce RoboTwin-UMI, a twenty-task simulation benchmark built on RoboTwin with UMI wrist-mounted fisheye observations, enabling controlled, repeatable evaluation of UMI policies under environment and embodiment changes separately and jointly without additional fine-tuning. On RoboTwin-UMI, Spatial-UMI-Dream achieves 79.10% in-domain success and 72.15% under combined embodiment and environment shifts, exceeding the strongest evaluated baseline in each setting by 4.65 and 10.30 percentage points, respectively. It also exhibits the smallest success-rate drop under embodiment transfer among the evaluated policies. In a matched pretraining ablation, RGB-only pretraining leads to a 5.75-percentage-point decrease in in-domain success compared with RGB-D pretraining. Across six real-world tasks, Spatial-UMI-Dream achieves 85.0% average success, exceeding the strongest baseline by 24.2 percentage points. Project page: https://weiduoyuan.com/spatial-umi-dream/
tldr: This paper introduces Spatial-UMI-Dream, a 5B spatial World Action Model pre-trained on 605 hours of RGB-D UMI data that jointly predicts future RGB, metric depth, and actions. It also presents RoboTwin-UMI, a 20-task simulation benchmark for evaluating UMI policies under embodiment and environment shifts, achieving strong real-world and simulated results.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了Spatial-UMI-Dream，一个基于605小时RGB-D UMI数据预训练的50亿参数空间世界动作模型，联合预测未来RGB、度量深度和动作；并构建了RoboTwin-UMI，一个20任务仿真基准，用于评估UMI策略在实体和环境变化下的表现，在真实和仿真环境中均取得了优异结果。
summary_zh: 通用操作接口（UMI）实现了独立于具体机器人的可扩展示范采集。然而，其移动的近距夹爪摄像头将相机运动与物体运动耦合在一起，缺乏稳定的外部视角，从而使得精确操作所需的度量几何信息隐含在RGB图像中。我们提出了Spatial-UMI-Dream，一个5B规模的空间世界动作模型（WAM），通过在605小时RGB-D UMI数据上的两阶段训练——先进行纯世界自适应，再进行世界-动作联合学习——来联合预测未来RGB图像、与鱼眼相机对齐的度量深度以及动作。由立体视觉导出的深度信息在统一的双夹爪RGB-D表示中明确了场景尺度与空间关系。此外，评估UMI策略需要检验UMI的机器人无关示范采集能否转化为策略跨机器人本体的泛化能力，同时还需考察其对环境变化的鲁棒性。我们引入了RoboTwin-UMI，一个基于RoboTwin构建的二十任务仿真基准，配备UMI腕戴式鱼眼相机观测，能够在环境变化和本体变化分别及联合设置下对UMI策略进行受控、可重复的评估，且无需额外微调。在RoboTwin-UMI上，Spatial-UMI-Dream在域内任务中取得了79.10%的成功率，在本体与环境联合迁移下取得72.15%的成功率，分别超过最强评估基线4.65和10.30个百分点。在所有被评估策略中，它在本体迁移下也表现出最小的成功率下降幅度。在匹配的预训练消融实验中，与RGB-D预训练相比，仅使用RGB预训练使域内成功率下降了5.75个百分点。在六个真实世界任务中，Spatial-UMI-Dream实现了85.0%的平均成功率，超过最强基线24.2个百分点。项目页面：https://weiduoyuan.com/spatial-umi-dream/

title: Perceptive Humanoid Motion from Simulation
summary: Humanoid robots have the potential to automate a wide range of physical tasks. Progress toward generalist humanoid autonomy, however, remains constrained by a data bottleneck: mapping pixels and free-form language to low-level joint commands requires paired supervision, and no corpus of such data exists at sufficiently large scale. Some approaches rely on human teleoperation and wearable capture devices, which require at least an hour of human time to produce an hour of data. We present HALO, a humanoid autonomy system powered by a pipeline that synthesizes vision-language-motion data across a thousand procedurally generated homes. The corpus scales with compute rather than human labor. HALO acquires a repertoire of physical skills, including sitting on chairs, navigating to named objects, stepping sideways through half-open doors, crouching and crawling beneath tables, and pushing boxes. It orchestrates these skills to solve composite, long-horizon tasks. Without ever seeing a real home during training, HALO transfers zero-shot to the physical world, achieving a 91% success rate across 360 trials in six unmapped real-world environments. See https://apple-aiml-research.github.io/ml-halo/ for code and videos.
tldr: HALO is a humanoid autonomy system that synthesizes vision-language-motion data in simulation across a thousand homes, enabling zero-shot transfer of physical skills to real-world environments with high success rates.
tldr_zh: HALO 是一个人形自主系统，通过在模拟的一千个家庭中合成视觉-语言-动作数据，实现了物理技能到真实世界的零样本迁移，成功率高达 91%。
summary_zh: 人形机器人有潜力实现多种体力任务的自动化。然而，迈向通用人形自主性的进展仍受制于数据瓶颈：将像素和自由形式的语言映射到低级关节指令需要成对的监督数据，而目前尚不存在足够大规模的这种数据集。一些方法依赖人类远程操作和可穿戴捕捉设备，这些方法至少需要一小时的人工时间才能产出一小时的数据。我们提出了HALO，这是一套人形自主系统，由一条跨一千个程序化生成家庭环境合成视觉-语言-运动数据的流水线驱动。该语料库的扩展依赖于计算而非人力。HALO习得一系列物理技能，包括坐在椅子上、导航至指定物体、侧身穿过半开的门、蹲下并爬过桌底、以及推箱子。它编排这些技能以解决复合的、长时程任务。在训练期间从未见过真实家庭环境的情况下，HALO零样本迁移至物理世界，在六个未映射的真实环境中的360次试验中取得了91%的成功率。代码和视频请参见 https://apple-aiml-research.github.io/ml-halo/ 。

title: From Pixels to Actions - Towards Native Vision-Language-Action Policies
summary: Vision-language-action models are typically built on a simple premise: perception is first compressed by visual encoders, and action reasoning begins only afterwards. Yet manipulation often hinges on precisely the visual signals most vulnerable to this abstraction, e.g., local geometry, boundaries, depth, and subtle state changes. This raises a fundamental question: should action policies inherit a fixed visual endpoint, or directly access evolving visual computation? We introduce NEO-VLA, a structurally encoder-free vision-language-action framework. Images are tokenized by lightweight patch convolutional layers and evolve jointly with language throughout the backbone, allowing a flow-matching action expert to draw from instruction-conditioned visual representations at different depths. This simple change reveals a consistent pattern. Native architectures outperform encoder-based counterparts under controlled comparisons; full fine-tuning reduces but does not erase the gap, and additional scale alone cannot recover it. More strikingly, layer-wise probing shows that the action-critical signals often peak well before the final visual representation. Across diverse manipulation settings and distribution shifts, NEO-VLA consequently achieves stronger and more robust control. Together, these results suggest that embodied control benefits from access to visual representations across the computational hierarchy, rather than a fixed encoder output.
tldr: The paper proposes NEO-VLA, an encoder-free vision-language-action framework where image patches are tokenized and processed jointly with language, enabling the action expert to access visual representations at multiple depths. This architecture outperforms encoder-based counterparts across manipulation tasks and distribution shifts, suggesting that policies benefit from intermediate visual features.
tldr_zh: 本文提出NEO-VLA，一种无编码器的视觉-语言-动作框架，其中图像块被标记化并与语言共同处理，使动作专家能够访问不同深度的视觉表示。该架构在多种操作任务和分布偏移下优于基于编码器的模型，表明策略受益于中间视觉特征。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作模型通常建立在一个简单的假设之上：感知首先由视觉编码器压缩，动作推理随后才开始。然而，操作任务往往依赖于恰恰最易受到这种抽象化处理影响的视觉信号，例如局部几何结构、边界、深度以及细微的状态变化。这引出了一个根本性问题：动作策略应当继承固定的视觉端点，还是直接访问不断演化的视觉计算过程？我们提出了NEO-VLA，一种结构上无需编码器的视觉-语言-动作框架。图像通过轻量级补丁卷积层进行令牌化，并与语言在整个骨干网络中共同演化，使得流匹配动作专家能够在不同深度从指令条件化的视觉表示中进行提取。这一简单的改变揭示了一致的规律。在受控比较下，原生架构优于基于编码器的对应架构；全参数微调缩小了差距但并未消除差距，而仅靠增加规模也无法弥补这一差距。更引人注目的是，逐层探查表明，动作关键信号往往在最终视觉表示形成之前就已达到峰值。在各种操作场景和分布偏移条件下，NEO-VLA因此实现了更强且更鲁棒的控制性能。综合来看，这些结果表明，具身控制受益于跨计算层级访问视觉表示，而非依赖固定的编码器输出。

title: MOMASPLAT: Dynamic Novel-View Demonstration Augmentation for Mobile Manipulation
summary: Visuomotor policies trained through imitation learning are highly sensitive to changes in camera viewpoint. This is particularly problematic for mobile manipulation (MoMa), where robots rarely execute manipulation from the exact same base pose used during demonstration collection due to navigation uncertainty, localization drift, and environmental constraints. Recent approaches use novel-view synthesis (NVS) to augment demonstrations with unseen viewpoints, but they assume static scenes and therefore fail to re-render the manipulated object during the post-contact interaction phase, leaving the most critical parts of the demonstration unaugmented. We present MOMASPLAT, a novel-view demonstration augmentation framework for mobile manipulation that synthesizes full manipulation trajectories from unseen robot base poses, including dynamic object interactions. Our key insight is that standard MoMa data collection naturally provides the multiview observations needed to reconstruct both the static scene and the manipulated object in 3D. MOMASPLAT combines 3D Gaussian Splatting, feed-forward 3D foundation models, and kinematics-based action retargeting to separately reconstruct the scene and manipulated object, render them from novel viewpoints, and generate geometrically consistent synthetic demonstrations paired with transformed actions. We evaluate MOMASPLAT on five real-world mobile manipulation tasks involving both rigid and articulated objects across three scenes, and validate the fidelity of its synthesized demonstrations against ground truth in simulation. MOMASPLAT substantially improves robustness to unseen base poses, more than doubling the average success rate of the strongest baseline and maintaining non-trivial success at large base displacements where all baselines fail, while reducing the need for largescale real-world data collection.
tldr: MOMASPLAT augments mobile manipulation demonstrations with novel views using 3D Gaussian Splatting and feed-forward 3D foundation models to separately reconstruct static scenes and manipulated objects, enabling dynamic object interaction synthesis and kinematically retargeted actions, which substantially improves policy robustness to unseen base poses.
tldr_zh: MOMASPLAT 利用 3D 高斯泼溅和前馈 3D 基础模型，分别重建静态场景和操作对象，生成动态物体交互的新视角演示并重定向动作，从而显著提升移动操作策略对未见基座姿态的鲁棒性。
summary_zh: 通过模仿学习训练的视觉运动策略对相机视角的变化高度敏感。这一问题在移动操作中尤为突出，因为导航不确定性、定位漂移及环境约束等因素，机器人很少能在与演示采集时完全相同的基座位姿下执行操作。近期方法利用新视角合成技术来扩充包含未见视角的演示数据，但这些方法假设场景为静态，因此无法在接触后交互阶段重新渲染被操作物体，导致演示中最关键的部分未被扩充。我们提出MOMASPLAT，一种面向移动操作的新视角演示扩充框架，能够从未见的机器人基座位姿合成完整的操作轨迹，包括动态物体交互。我们的核心洞察在于，标准的移动操作数据采集过程天然提供了重建静态场景和被操作物体三维结构所需的多视角观测。MOMASPLAT结合三维高斯泼溅、前馈三维基础模型以及基于运动学的动作重定向，分别重建场景与被操作物体，从新视角渲染二者，并生成与变换后动作配对的几何一致合成演示。我们在涉及刚体和铰接物体的五个真实世界移动操作任务、三个场景中评估了MOMASPLAT，并在仿真中对照真实值验证了其合成演示的保真度。MOMASPLAT显著提升了对未见基座位姿的鲁棒性，将最强基线的平均成功率提高一倍以上，并在所有基线均失败的大幅基座位移条件下仍保持非平凡的成功率，同时降低了对大规模真实世界数据采集的需求。

title: GPWM: Modeling the World as 3D Particle Motion
summary: We introduce GPWM, a Generative Particle World Model that predicts how 3D scenes evolve by generating the motion of particles and rigid bodies over time. Unlike video world models that generate scene appearance, GPWM operates directly in 3D physical space. A single representation and architecture cover rigid, deformable, cloth, and granular materials, in both passive physics and robotic interaction. GPWM is an object-aware multi-resolution transformer that combines flow matching with diffusion forcing to generate coherent physical trajectories far beyond its training horizon. We train and evaluate GPWM on ParticleWorlds, a 25.5-million-frame corpus spanning diverse geometries, materials, interactions, and robot embodiments. GPWM outperforms the best prior learned-dynamics baseline in each of six physical domains, reducing prediction error by 31% on average. Breaking from the domain-specific setting of prior methods, a single Unified GPWM models these heterogeneous regimes with one set of weights, largely outperforming per-domain baselines and even surpassing our own specialist models in two domains. GPWM further generalizes to unseen geometries, physical properties, object counts, and rollout horizons. Beyond prediction, GPWM enables contact-rich planning by learning a generative prior over joint actuator-object motion. Instead of searching over unconstrained actions, planning searches the model's latent noise for interactions that achieve a desired object-space goal. With the same world model, noise-space planning substantially outperforms action-space search on pushing and picking, where complex contact sequences are hard to discover. Executed open-loop in simulation, the resulting plans achieve goal-directed manipulation without reference action trajectories or goal-specific policies.
tldr: GPWM is a generative particle world model that predicts 3D scene evolution by generating particle and rigid-body motion, using a multi-resolution transformer with flow matching and diffusion forcing. It shows superior performance across diverse physical domains and enables contact-rich planning via noise-space search for robotic manipulation.
tldr_zh: GPWM是一种生成式粒子世界模型，通过生成粒子和刚体的运动来预测3D场景演化，采用结合流匹配和扩散强制机制的多分辨率Transformer，在多个物理领域表现优异，并支持通过噪声空间搜索实现接触丰富的机器人操纵规划。
summary_zh: 我们推出了GPWM，一种生成式粒子世界模型，能够通过预测粒子和刚体随时间的运动来模拟3D场景的演变。与生成场景外观的视频世界模型不同，GPWM直接在3D物理空间中操作。一个统一的表示与架构即可覆盖刚体、可变形体、布料及颗粒材料，并适用于被动物理场景与机器人交互场景。GPWM是一种对象感知的多分辨率Transformer，结合流匹配与扩散强制技术，能够生成远超其训练时域范围的连贯物理轨迹。我们在ParticleWorlds上对GPWM进行了训练与评估，该数据集包含2550万帧，涵盖多样的几何形状、材料、交互及机器人形态。在六个物理领域中，GPWM均优于先前最优的学习型动力学基线模型，平均预测误差降低31%。与先前方法针对特定领域建模不同，统一的GPWM以单一权重集建模这些异构场景，大幅超越各领域独立基线模型，甚至在其中两个领域中超过了我们自己的专家模型。此外，GPWM还能泛化至未见过的几何形状、物理属性、物体数量及推演时域。除预测外，GPWM还通过学习联合执行器-物体运动的生成先验，实现了接触丰富的规划能力。规划过程不再搜索无约束的动作空间，而是在模型的潜在噪声空间中搜索实现目标物体空间状态所需的交互。在相同的世界模型下，噪声空间规划在推动和抓取任务上显著优于动作空间搜索，这些任务中复杂接触序列难以发现。在仿真中开环执行时，所得到的规划能够实现目标导向的操作，而无需参考动作轨迹或特定目标策略。

title: RoboARCade: Benchmarking Agentic Robot Control
summary: Improvements in multi-modal capabilities have enabled agents to act directly as robot policies, a setting we refer to as agentic robot control (ARC). We introduce RoboARCade, a benchmark of long-horizon manipulation tasks across three embodiments designed to test in-context adaptation, memory, and reasoning for precise control. The tasks build on existing open-source benchmarks, which we make harder by widening the range of initial conditions. RoboARCade is easy to use and extend: all tasks run on a single simulation backend, MuJoCo, each task is a self-contained data pack, and agents connect through interchangeable interfaces, so new tasks, agents, and interfaces can be added independently. The benchmark separates leading agents: GPT-6 Astra achieves 49.8% compared with 43.6% for Claude Fable 5.1, leaving substantial room for improvement. Comparing two interfaces, we find that a richer visual interface adds only 1.5 to 6.8 points at 1.7 to 2.3 times the cost. Failures stem mostly from choosing a poor manipulation strategy or executing a good one imprecisely, rarely from misunderstanding the scene, and agents incorrectly claim success on 24% to 39% of attempted subtasks. Agents can also improve without human input: one successful demonstration in context raises Astra's score from 53.5% to 73.0% on a five-task subset, and a prompt the agent writes and revises itself reaches 72.0%. Code, videos and full traces are available at roboarcade.org.
tldr: RoboARCade is a benchmark for agentic robot control, featuring long-horizon manipulation tasks across three embodiments in MuJoCo, designed to test in-context adaptation, memory, and reasoning. It reveals gaps in current VLA agents and provides a flexible framework for evaluation.
tldr_zh: RoboARCade是一个用于智能体机器人控制的基准测试，包含MuJoCo中三种具身形态的长期操作任务，旨在测试上下文适应、记忆和推理能力。它揭示了当前VLA智能体的不足，并提供了一个灵活的评估框架。
summary_zh: 多模态能力的提升使智能体能够直接充当机器人策略，我们将这一设定称为智能体机器人控制（ARC）。我们推出了RoboARCade，一个跨越三种具身形态的长时程操作任务基准，旨在测试智能体在精准控制中的情境适应能力、记忆和推理能力。这些任务建立在现有的开源基准之上，通过扩大初始条件范围使其更具挑战性。RoboARCade易于使用和扩展：所有任务均在同一仿真后端MuJoCo上运行，每个任务都是自包含的数据包，智能体通过可互换的接口连接，因此新任务、新智能体和新接口可以独立添加。该基准拉开了领先智能体之间的差距：GPT-6 Astra达到49.8%，而Claude Fable 5.1为43.6%，仍有较大提升空间。对比两种接口，我们发现更丰富的视觉接口仅增加1.5至6.8个百分点的得分，但成本却是原来的1.7至2.3倍。失败主要源于选择了较差的操控策略或对良好策略执行不够精确，很少是因为对场景的误解，且智能体在24%至39%的尝试子任务中错误地声称成功。智能体也能在没有人工输入的情况下改进：在上下文中提供一次成功演示，可使Astra在五个任务的子集上得分从53.5%提升至73.0%，而由智能体自行编写和修订的提示词则达到72.0%。代码、视频和完整轨迹可在roboarcade.org获取。

title: Reinforcing End-to-End Autonomous Driving Safety via Negative-Aware Planning in a Unified World-Action Model
summary: World-action models (WAMs) jointly model future traffic states and driving actions for end-to-end autonomous driving in intelligent transportation systems. However, their action learning remains dominated by expert-trajectory imitation, leaving unsafe alternatives close to expert trajectories insufficiently constrained. To improve WAM robustness in safety-critical scenarios, we propose NegWAM, a safety post-training framework for unified WAMs that learns explicit safety boundaries from near-expert failure trajectories. NegWAM constructs negative trajectories that are geometrically close to the expert trajectory yet carry safety risks, uses them as repulsive anchors to steer predictions away from dangerous behavior, and encodes them as scene-conditioned rider tokens to learn scene--trajectory compatibility. During training, NegWAM jointly optimizes the flow-matching and near-expert negative objectives, while the auxiliary rider branch is discarded at inference, incurring no additional overhead. On NAVSIM v2, NegWAM achieves 40.4 EPDMS on navhard, a 4.1% relative improvement over the strongest compared scorer-free WAM baseline, and achieves 93.3 EPDMS on navtest. These results demonstrate that NegWAM achieves strong performance in safety-critical scenarios while preserving routine-driving performance. Zero-shot closed-loop evaluation on HUGSIM further demonstrates cross-benchmark generalization. The code is available at https://github.com/Zizizi-hao/NegWAM.
tldr: NegWAM is a safety post-training framework for unified world-action models in end-to-end driving, which constructs near-expert negative trajectories to learn explicit safety boundaries and improves safety-critical performance without extra inference overhead.
tldr_zh: NegWAM 是一种用于端到端驾驶统一世界动作模型的安全后训练框架，通过构造接近专家的负轨迹来学习明确的安全边界，在不增加推理开销的情况下提升安全关键场景的性能。
summary_zh: 世界动作模型（WAMs）联合建模未来交通状态与驾驶动作，用于智能交通系统中的端到端自动驾驶。然而，其动作学习仍以专家轨迹模仿为主导，导致接近专家轨迹的不安全备选方案未能得到充分约束。为提升WAM在安全关键场景中的鲁棒性，我们提出NegWAM——一种面向统一WAM的安全后训练框架，可从近专家失败轨迹中学习显式安全边界。NegWAM构建与专家轨迹几何接近但存在安全风险的负轨迹，将其作为排斥锚点引导预测远离危险行为，并将其编码为场景条件化骑手令牌以学习场景-轨迹兼容性。训练过程中，NegWAM联合优化流匹配与近专家负目标，而在推理阶段丢弃辅助骑手分支，不引入额外开销。在NAVSIM v2上，NegWAM在navhard基准上达到40.4 EPDMS，相较于最强无评分器WAM基线相对提升4.1%，并在navtest上达到93.3 EPDMS。这些结果表明，NegWAM在安全关键场景中实现了强性能，同时保持了常规驾驶性能。在HUGSIM上的零样本闭环评估进一步验证了跨基准泛化能力。代码已开源：https://github.com/Zizizi-hao/NegWAM。

title: STEP: Spatiotemporal Training with Explicit Prediction for Perceptive Humanoid Locomotion
summary: For perceptive humanoid locomotion, the relevance of terrain geometry depends on the robot's body state and how both evolve under its actions. Existing work has advanced terrain-aware sensory fusion and cross-modal prediction, improving how visual and proprioceptive information is combined and related. However, feature aggregation alone does not specify which cross-modal relationships should be learned, while prediction between simultaneous observations does not explicitly constrain their action-dependent evolution. We present Spatiotemporal Training with Explicit Prediction (STEP), a one-stage framework that jointly supervises cross-modal relationships and action-dependent state evolution within a shared control representation. Multiple learned queries aggregate depth and proprioceptive tokens into a compact policy state. Bidirectional masked prediction uses each visible modality to predict latent features of the omitted modality, explicitly supervising terrain-body relationships. An action-conditioned predictor maps the current policy state and executed action to the next fused state, with an exponential-moving-average target defined directly in the policy representation space. Simulation comparisons show overall improvements in terrain traversal over evaluated fusion alternatives and ablations, while depth-dropout and delay experiments demonstrate the benefits of both predictive objectives under degraded visual input. Deployed on a 23-DoF Noetix E1 humanoid with onboard sensing, STEP succeeds in 98 of 100 hardware trials across stairs, a 40\,cm platform, a 70\,cm gap, stepping stones, and backward stair traversal without rearward terrain visibility.
tldr: STEP is a one-stage framework for perceptive humanoid locomotion that jointly supervises cross-modal relationships between depth and proprioception via bidirectional masked prediction and action-conditioned state evolution, improving terrain traversal in simulation and achieving 98/100 success on a real 23-DoF humanoid.
tldr_zh: STEP 是一个用于感知人形机器人行走的单阶段框架，通过双向掩码预测联合监督深度与本体感觉的跨模态关系，并经行动条件预测状态演化，在仿真中提升地形穿越性能，并在真实 23 自由度人形机器人上实现 98/100 的成功率。
summary_zh: 面向具身智能的人形机器人运动，地形几何的相关性取决于机器人自身状态以及两者在其动作作用下的演化方式。现有工作已推进了地形感知的传感器融合与跨模态预测，改善了视觉与本体感觉信息的结合与关联方式。然而，仅靠特征聚合无法指定应学习哪些跨模态关系，而对同步观测之间的预测也未显式约束其动作依赖的演化过程。我们提出了一种带显式预测的时空训练方法（STEP），这是一个单阶段框架，在共享控制表示中联合监督跨模态关系与动作依赖的状态演化。多个可学习的查询将深度特征与本体感受特征聚合为紧凑的策略状态。双向掩码预测利用每种可见模态预测被省略模态的潜在特征，从而显式监督地形—身体关系。一个以动作条件化的预测器将当前策略状态与所执行动作映射至下一融合状态，并在策略表示空间中直接定义指数移动平均目标。仿真对比表明，与所评估的融合替代方案及消融实验相比，该方法在地形穿越方面总体表现更优，同时深度信息丢弃与延迟实验验证了在视觉输入退化情况下两种预测目标的优势。该方法已部署于具备机载感知的23自由度Noetix E1人形机器人，在楼梯、40厘米平台、70厘米间隙、踏脚石以及无后方地形可见性的倒走楼梯穿越共100次硬件试验中取得了98次成功。

title: Terrain-Indexed Motion Priors and Geometric Support for Extreme Humanoid Parkour
summary: We present a progressive imitation framework that learns terrain-appropriate humanoid parkour skills and subsequently adapts their hand--knee support. Human demonstrations provide traversal behaviors, but their contact patterns need not suit a robot's proportions or the available support surfaces. Our framework changes the role of demonstrations across three stages: privileged imitation produces physically executable robot references; terrain-indexed adversarial motion priors guide skill acquisition; and geometric support guidance with a reduced motion-prior weight enables contact adaptation. Candidate-based precontact attraction and actual-contact evaluation guide support without prescribing a contact sequence. The deployed policy selects behaviors from onboard depth, proprioception, and velocity commands without an external skill label. On the Noetix E1, the policy achieves 96.34\% hybrid success in simulation and transfers without real-world policy fine-tuning, completing 29 of 30 individual obstacle trials and four of five hybrid courses. Support-adaptation ablations show higher traversal success for the complete adaptation stage on the tested terrains, while qualitative observations show changes in contact placement. These results support acquiring skills from demonstrations before relaxing their influence to accommodate robot-specific support configurations.
tldr: This paper introduces a progressive imitation framework for humanoid parkour that learns terrain-appropriate skills from demonstrations and adapts hand-knee support via geometric guidance, achieving successful sim-to-real transfer without fine-tuning.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种渐进式模仿框架，用于人形机器人跑酷，从演示中学习地形适应的技能，并通过几何引导调整手膝支撑，实现了无需微调的仿真到现实迁移。
summary_zh: 我们提出了一种渐进式模仿框架，用于学习适合地形的类人机器人跑酷技能，并随后调整其手膝支撑方式。人类演示提供了穿越行为，但其接触模式未必适配机器人的身体比例或可用的支撑表面。该框架在三个不同阶段中调整了演示的作用：特权模仿阶段生成物理上可执行的机器人参考动作；基于地形索引的对抗性运动先验指导技能习得；结合降低运动先验权重的几何支撑引导实现接触适应。基于候选的接触前吸引与实际接触评估共同引导支撑，而无需预设接触序列。部署后的策略仅依赖机载深度感知、本体感觉和速度指令选择行为，无需外部技能标签。在Noetix E1平台上，该策略在仿真中实现了96.34%的混合成功率，并且无需真实世界策略微调即可直接迁移，在30次单障碍物试验中完成29次，在5条混合路线中完成4条。支撑适应消融实验表明，在测试地形上，完整适应阶段具有更高的穿越成功率，同时定性观察结果显示了接触位置的变化。这些结果支持先通过演示获取技能，再放宽其影响以适应机器人特定支撑配置的训练范式。

title: Time-Indexed Skill Success Models for Latency-Aware Skill Selection and Timing in Dynamic Manipulation
summary: Robots that manipulate moving objects act on observations that are outdated when the chosen skill starts, and the best skill can change within a few hundred milliseconds. Skill competence models, however, predict success for a launch at the moment of observation. We propose time-indexed skill success models, which predict whole-task success when a skill is launched after a given delay. Trained on rollouts branched at a grid of launch delays, they let a receding-horizon planner select both the skill and its launch time under fixed or random latency. In a MuJoCo study in which a UR5e captures a sliding puck with three skills, the planner exceeded a static competence model by 2.8 to 6.2 percentage points at 100 to 300 ms of latency, including when that model was evaluated on point or sampled forecasts of the launch state. Across five complete runs (three training seeds and two distribution shifts), all 80 paired 95% intervals against four baselines excluded zero. On delayed launches, the time-indexed model was calibrated (expected calibration error 0.009 against 0.239), and pausing the world during latency overstated success by up to 23 points. On a real UR5e that captures a rolling ball after 0.2 s of injected latency, a static model trained in a hardware-matched simulator predicted 99% success on a prespecified subset of 35 delayed launches that it rated at least 0.8. Of these, 63% succeeded (95% interval 46 to 77%), and the time-indexed model predicted 56%. In this single-skill, predictable regime, a matched physics-based forecast was also well calibrated.
tldr: This paper introduces time-indexed skill success models that predict task success for skills launched after a delay, enabling a receding-horizon planner to select skills and launch times under latency. Experiments in MuJoCo and on a real UR5e show improved success rates over static competence models in dynamic manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了时间索引技能成功模型，用于预测延迟后启动技能的任务成功率，使滚动时域规划器能在延迟下选择技能和启动时间。在MuJoCo和真实UR5e上的实验表明，在动态操作任务中，该模型相较于静态能力模型提高了成功率。
summary_zh: 摘要：操控移动物体的机器人在选定技能启动时，所依据的观测信息已经过时，而最佳技能可能在数百毫秒内发生变化。然而，技能能力模型是在观测时刻预测启动时的成功率。我们提出了时间索引技能成功模型，该模型在技能经过给定延迟后启动时，预测整个任务的成功率。该模型在按延迟启动时间网格进行分支的 rollout 数据上训练，使得滚动时域规划器能够在固定或随机延迟下，同时选择技能及其启动时间。在一项 MuJoCo 研究中，UR5e 机械臂通过三种技能捕获滑动的冰球，在 100 至 300 毫秒延迟下，该规划器比静态能力模型高出 2.8 至 6.2 个百分点，包括当该模型基于启动状态的点预测或采样预测进行评估时也是如此。在五次完整运行（三种训练种子和两种分布偏移）中，与四个基线相比，所有 80 个配对 95% 置信区间均不包含零。在延迟启动情况下，时间索引模型具有良好的校准性（期望校准误差为 0.009，而对比模型为 0.239），并且在延迟期间暂停世界会高估成功率多达 23 个百分点。在真实 UR5e 机械臂上，在注入 0.2 秒延迟后捕获滚动球的实验中，一个在硬件匹配模拟器中训练的静态模型，对于预设的 35 次延迟启动中评分不低于 0.8 的子集，预测成功率为 99%。其中，实际成功率为 63%（95% 置信区间为 46% 至 77%），而时间索引模型预测成功率为 56%。在这种单技能、可预测的场景下，基于物理的匹配预测也具有良好的校准性。

title: GuidedWAM: Training-Free Energy Guidance for World Action Models in Autonomous Driving
summary: World action models (WAMs) for autonomous driving couple the driving policy and the visual world model in a single generative network whose objectives are fixed post-training. Conditioning on a new driving objective requires retraining. We study energy guidance as a general mechanism and present GuidedWAM, a model-agnostic framework for injecting driving objectives into frozen WAMs at sampling time. Our framework constructs each objective as differentiable energies on the sampler's intermediate clean-action estimate, which needs only forward access to the frozen model, and is stabilized by sampling-time guidance scheduling, per-energy normalization, and velocity-bounded correction. On the NAVSIM v2 hard-split, guidance improves all three frozen, publicly released WAMs by 1.8 to 3.6 EPDMS, averaged over three sampler seeds, and adds less than 10% to the sampling time per step. These results position energy guidance as a practical post-training control channel for WAMs.
tldr: GuidedWAM introduces a training-free energy guidance framework that injects differentiable driving objectives into frozen world action models at sampling time, improving performance on NAVSIM v2 with minimal computational overhead.
tldr_zh: GuidedWAM 提出了一种无需训练的能量引导框架，在采样时将驾驶目标注入冻结的世界动作模型，在 NAVSIM v2 上提升性能且开销极小。
summary_zh: 世界动作模型（WAMs）在自动驾驶领域将驾驶策略与视觉世界模型耦合于单一生成网络中，其训练目标在训练完成后固定不变。若要适配新的驾驶目标，则需重新训练。本文研究能量引导作为一种通用机制，并提出GuidedWAM——一个模型无关的框架，用于在采样阶段将驾驶目标注入冻结的WAMs。该框架将每个目标构建为采样器中间干净动作估计上的可微能量，仅需对冻结模型进行前向访问，并通过采样时引导调度、逐能量归一化及速度有界校正实现稳定。在NAVSIM v2困难划分下，引导使三个冻结的公开WAMs在三种采样器种子上的平均EPDMS提升1.8至3.6，且每步采样时间增加不超过10%。这些结果表明，能量引导可作为WAMs的一种实用的训练后控制通道。

title: TactileLab: Sim-to-Real Dexterous Robot Manipulation with Efficient Shear-Sensitive Tactile Simulation
summary: Robotic simulators that represent shear within tactile sensing are becoming increasingly important for contact-rich manipulation. However, simulating contact shear with high-fidelity deformable or soft-body simulation is computationally demanding, limiting scalability to large-scale reinforcement learning. Here we introduce \textit{TactileLab}, a scalable multimodal tactile simulation framework built on IsaacLab, with a particular focus on a new optical-flow-based tactile representation termed \textit{simulated tactile flow}. Instead of relying on soft-body physics to model shear deformation, TactileLab uses rigid-body simulation to efficiently estimate dense tangential motion at the contact interface, producing tactile flow fields that encode shear-relevant contact dynamics. This flow field complements geometric features from a contact depth field. We further introduce a novel policy architecture for jointly processing long-horizon proprioceptive signals and rich tactile observations. Across multiple contact-rich tasks, policies trained using simulated tactile flow learn efficiently at scale and exhibit emergent contact-aware behaviours. To facilitate sim-to-real policy deployment, we then propose a novel real-to-sim tactile translation method that maps real tactile image streams to simulated tactile flow and depth fields, together with a new tactile data collection method, and validate it across diverse tactile sensor designs. Using this pipeline, we demonstrate real-world deployment on tasks encompassing dual-arm and dexterous in-hand manipulation. Overall, TactileLab provides an end-to-end sim-to-real framework for scalable tactile policy learning, enabling diverse shear-sensitive manipulation across heterogeneous tactile robotic systems.
tldr: TactileLab is a scalable tactile simulation framework on IsaacLab that uses optical-flow-based simulated tactile flow to efficiently encode shear contact dynamics, enabling sim-to-real dexterous manipulation across diverse tactile sensors.
tldr_zh: TactileLab 是基于 IsaacLab 的可扩展触觉仿真框架，利用光流式模拟触觉流高效编码剪切接触动力学，支持跨多种触觉传感器的灵巧操作仿真到现实迁移。
summary_zh: 摘要：在触觉传感中表征剪切力的机器人模拟器，对于接触丰富的操作任务正变得越来越重要。然而，利用高保真度的可变形或软体模拟来仿真接触剪切力，计算成本高昂，限制了其在大规模强化学习中的可扩展性。本文介绍了 \textit{TactileLab}——一个基于IsaacLab构建的可扩展多模态触觉模拟框架，其核心创新在于一种基于光流的新型触觉表征，称为\textit{模拟触觉流}。TactileLab不依赖软体物理来建模剪切变形，而是利用刚体模拟高效估计接触界面处的密集切向运动，生成编码剪切相关接触动力学的触觉流场。该流场补充了接触深度场的几何特征。我们进一步提出了一种新颖的策略架构，用于联合处理长期本体感觉信号和丰富的触觉观测。在多个接触丰富型任务中，使用模拟触觉流训练的策略能够在大规模下高效学习，并展现出涌现的接触感知行为。为促进仿真到现实的策略部署，我们随后提出了一种新颖的实景到仿真触觉转换方法，将真实触觉图像流映射为模拟触觉流和深度场，并配套提出了一种新的触觉数据采集方法，已在多种触觉传感器设计上得到验证。利用该流程，我们在双臂操作和灵巧手内操作等任务上展示了真实世界的部署效果。总体而言，TactileLab提供了一套端到端的仿真到现实框架，支持可扩展的触觉策略学习，使异构触觉机器人系统能够实现多样化的剪切敏感操作。

title: Learning Robotic World Models with Semantic and Visual Feedback
summary: Robot world models predict action-conditioned future visual states to support robotic planning and decision making. However, visual reconstruction does not fully capture task progress, semantic evaluation alone provides limited constraints on fine-grained visual errors, and homogeneous predictions limit comparative feedback. We present RoboImagine, a framework for post-training autoregressive robotic world models through candidate-future comparisons with semantic and visual feedback. Diverse search promotes diversity among candidate trajectories under shared visual observations, action sequences, and task instructions. A frozen multimodal evaluator provides task-relevant semantic preferences through pairwise video comparisons in both presentation orders, complemented by pixel- and perceptual-level visual consistency feedback that constrains local structural and appearance errors. These signals drive policy optimization through group-relative advantages. Fixed initial context and branch-specific rolling histories support long-sequence generation with bounded context and consistent conditioning between candidate generation and policy optimization. Experiments with separately trained models on RT-1, BridgeV2, and RoboCasa cover real-world and simulated manipulation. On RT-1, under matched initialization, update counts, and evaluation protocols, RoboImagine improves PSNR by 1.26 dB and reduces LPIPS by 11.93% relative to continued supervised fine-tuning. Ablations show that diverse search improves prediction quality and that combined semantic and visual feedback yields higher external multimodal evaluation scores than visual feedback alone while maintaining comparable visual fidelity. Rolling histories further improve long-horizon prediction. These results support improving visual fidelity, task relevance, and long-horizon prediction through candidate comparison and complementary feedback.
tldr: This paper introduces RoboImagine, a framework that post-trains autoregressive robotic world models by comparing candidate future trajectories with semantic and visual feedback, improving visual fidelity, task relevance, and long-horizon prediction on manipulation datasets.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了RoboImagine框架，通过对比候选未来轨迹并结合语义与视觉反馈来后训练自回归机器人世界模型，从而提升视觉保真度、任务相关性和长期预测能力。
summary_zh: 机器人世界模型预测以行动为条件的未来视觉状态，以支持机器人规划和决策。然而，视觉重建并不能完全捕捉任务进展，仅靠语义评估对细粒度视觉错误的约束有限，且同质化的预测限制了对比较性反馈的获取。我们提出RoboImagine，一种通过候选未来比较并结合语义与视觉反馈来对自回归机器人世界模型进行后训练的框架。多样化搜索在共享视觉观察、动作序列和任务指令下促进候选轨迹之间的多样性。一个冻结的多模态评估器通过双向配对视频比较提供任务相关的语义偏好，并辅以像素级和感知级的视觉一致性反馈，以约束局部结构和外观误差。这些信号通过组内相对优势驱动策略优化。固定的初始上下文和分支特定的滚动历史支持在有限上下文条件下进行长序列生成，并确保候选生成与策略优化之间条件设置的一致性。在RT-1、BridgeV2和RoboCasa上分别训练模型的实验涵盖了真实世界与模拟操纵任务。在RT-1上，在匹配初始化、更新次数和评估协议的情况下，RoboImagine相较于持续监督微调，PSNR提高1.26 dB，LPIPS降低11.93%。消融实验表明，多样化搜索提升了预测质量，并且语义与视觉反馈的组合相比仅使用视觉反馈，在保持可比较视觉保真度的同时，获得了更高的外部多模态评估分数。滚动历史进一步改善了长时域预测。这些结果支持通过候选比较和互补反馈提升视觉保真度、任务相关性和长时域预测能力。

title: Semantics-to-Contact: A Stagewise Framework for Robust Contact-Rich Manipulation
summary: Contact-rich manipulation requires precise control under complex contact dynamics while remaining robust to diverse visual conditions. However, real-world reinforcement learning often overfits to the visual appearance of training scenes. We propose Semantics-to-Contact (S2C), a stagewise framework for visually robust contact-rich manipulation. The insight is to decompose the problem into two stages: semantic focusing and contact refinement. In the first stage, a vision-language model localizes task-relevant regions across visually diverse scenes, providing coarse spatial guidance and reducing the burden of exploration. In the second stage, a real-world human-in-the-loop residual reinforcement learning policy learns fine-grained contact behaviors within the localized region using force feedback. To further improve visual robustness, we introduce an object-centric visual augmentation strategy that randomizes background appearance while preserving the robot and task-relevant objects. Experiments on six contact-rich real-world manipulation tasks exhibit that S2C consistently improves success rates over strong baselines and maintains reliable performance under significant visual and positional variations. These results demonstrate that stagewise semantic focusing and contact refinement provide a practical path toward visually robust real-world contact-rich manipulation. Our demos can be seen in https://edem-ai.github.io/S2C/.
tldr: The paper introduces Semantics-to-Contact (S2C), a stagewise framework that uses a vision-language model for semantic focusing and human-in-the-loop residual reinforcement learning for contact refinement, achieving robust contact-rich manipulation under visual variations in six real-world tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了Semantics-to-Contact (S2C)框架，通过视觉语言模型进行语义聚焦和人在环残差强化学习进行接触细化，在六个真实世界任务中实现了视觉变化下鲁棒的接触丰富操作。
summary_zh: 接触丰富的操作需要在复杂的接触动力学下实现精确控制，同时保持对不同视觉条件的鲁棒性。然而，现实世界中的强化学习往往对训练场景的视觉外观产生过拟合。我们提出语义到接触（Semantics-to-Contact，S2C）框架，一种用于视觉鲁棒的接触丰富操作的分阶段方法。其核心思想是将问题分解为两个阶段：语义聚焦和接触细化。在第一阶段，视觉语言模型在视觉多样的场景中定位与任务相关的区域，提供粗略的空间引导，并减少探索的负担。在第二阶段，一种真实世界中人类参与的回环残差强化学习策略利用力反馈在局部区域内学习精细的接触行为。为了进一步提升视觉鲁棒性，我们引入了一种以对象为中心的视觉增强策略，该策略在保持机器人和任务相关对象不变的同时，随机化背景外观。在六个接触丰富的真实世界操作任务上的实验表明，S2C在成功率上持续优于强基线，并在显著的视觉和位置变化下保持可靠的性能。这些结果表明，分阶段的语义聚焦和接触细化为实现视觉鲁棒的真实世界接触丰富操作提供了一条实用路径。我们的演示视频可在 https://edem-ai.github.io/S2C/ 查看。

title: LMGN: A Unified Policy Learning Model for Last-Mile Grasp-Navigation
summary: Legged robots equipped with manipulators have shown significant potential in the fields of daily life and industry in complex environments. However, existing methods mainly focus on global navigation or manipulation independently, while overlooking the last-mile navigation problem, where the robot must jointly determine the base placement, approach direction, and grasp execution to achieve reliable object grasping, and different manipulation stages require distinct control behaviors. To address these challenges, we propose Last-Mile Grasp-Navigation (LMGN), a unified policy learning model for Quadruped robot loco-manipulation. An Explicit Distance and Directional Reachability (ED-DR) representation is first introduced to explicitly represent the features of grasp-compatible base placement and approach direction. We then develop a semantically aligned Hierarchical Mixture-of-Experts (HMoE) policy that models stage-aware behaviors across the stages of base adjustment, pre-grasp alignment and grasp execution, and object lift. Finally, a new optimization method that jointly aligns navigation and manipulation, stage-dependent expert routing, and action-level consistency is proposed to optimize the HMoE policy. Extensive experiments on the Habitat and Isaac Gym simulators demonstrate that LMGN consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods, denoting that integrating grasp-aware reachability with stage-aware policy learning significantly improves the success rates of last-mile navigation and target grasp for robots.
tldr: This paper introduces LMGN, a unified policy learning model for last-mile grasp-navigation on quadruped robots, which integrates an Explicit Distance and Directional Reachability representation with a semantically aligned Hierarchical Mixture-of-Experts policy, demonstrating improved success rates in simulations over existing methods.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了LMGN，一种用于四足机器人末段抓取导航的统一策略学习模型，结合显式距离与方向可达性表示和语义对齐的分层专家混合策略，在仿真中相比现有方法显著提高了成功率。
summary_zh: 配备机械臂的四足机器人在复杂环境下的日常生活与工业领域中展现出巨大应用潜力。然而，现有方法主要侧重于全局导航或独立操作，忽视了“最后一英里导航”问题——即机器人必须联合确定基座位置、接近方向并执行抓取，以实现可靠的目标抓取，且不同操作阶段需要不同的控制行为。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了一种名为Last-Mile Grasp-Navigation (LMGN)的统一策略学习模型，用于四足机器人移动操作。首先引入显式距离与方向可达性（ED-DR）表示，以显式表征与抓取兼容的基座位置及接近方向特征。随后，我们开发了一种语义对齐的层次化混合专家（HMoE）策略，该策略能够对基座调整、预抓取对齐、抓取执行及物体抬升等阶段中的阶段感知行为进行建模。最后，提出了一种联合优化方法，该方法同时对齐导航与操作、阶段相关的专家路由及动作级一致性，以优化HMoE策略。在Habitat和Isaac Gym模拟器上的大量实验表明，LMGN始终优于现有最先进方法，证明将抓取感知可达性与阶段感知策略学习相结合，能显著提高机器人最后一英里导航及目标抓取的成功率。

title: MessyNav: Zero-Shot Navigation via Manipulation in Messy Environments
summary: Real-world environments are messy, with paths often blocked by everyday objects like chairs and toys, requiring robots to perform interactive navigation by manipulating obstacles to clear a path. Existing methods rely on extensive simulation-based learning or per-scene instructions specifying which objects to avoid or manipulate. They struggle to generalize across novel objects, diverse environments, and varied contexts such as a cart of fragile glassware that should be avoided while an empty one can be pushed. We formalize this problem as open-world interactive navigation and present MessyNav, a zero-shot framework based on vision-language models (VLMs). At its core, MessyNav performs explicit VLM-based affordance reasoning before task planning to decide whether to swipe, pick up, or avoid an object and produce a high-level plan. Evaluated on a mobile manipulator across real-world indoor and outdoor environments, MessyNav improves success rate by 27 percentage points (pp) over the strongest baseline in real-robot trials and achieves statistically significant gains in a larger-scale offline evaluation, without task-specific training.
tldr: MessyNav presents a zero-shot vision-language-model-based framework for interactive navigation in messy environments, where VLMs reason about object affordances to decide whether to manipulate or avoid obstacles, improving real-robot success rates by 27pp without task-specific training.
tldr_zh: MessyNav 提出了一种基于视觉语言模型的零样本交互式导航框架，通过推理物体可操纵性来决定是否避开或移动障碍物，在真实机器人试验中成功率提升 27 个百分点且无需任务特定训练。
summary_zh: 现实世界环境杂乱无章，路径常常被椅子、玩具等日常物品阻挡，这要求机器人通过操纵障碍物来清理通道，实现交互式导航。现有方法依赖于大量的基于模拟的学习，或针对每个场景的指令来指定应避开或操纵哪些物体。这些方法在应对新颖物体、多样环境及多种情境时泛化能力不足——例如，满载易碎玻璃器皿的推车应予以避让，而空推车则可以被推开。我们将此问题形式化为开放世界交互式导航，并提出了MessyNav——一种基于视觉语言模型（VLMs）的零样本框架。其核心在于，MessyNav在任务规划之前进行显式的基于VLM的可供性推理，以决定是推离、拾起还是避开某个物体，并制定高层计划。在真实室内外环境中，于移动操纵平台上进行的评估显示，MessyNav在真实机器人试验中的成功率较最强基线提高了27个百分点（pp），并在更大规模的离线评估中取得了统计学上显著的提升，且无需任务特定训练。

title: cuRoboV2-Fast: Fast Torque-Limited Collision-Free Motion Planning
summary: We present cuRoboV2-Fast, a GPU-accelerated planner that reduces both planning latency and execution time for collision-free, payload-aware, torque-limited motions. B-spline trajectory optimization reduces the required iterations, while accelerated robot computations and differentiable inverse dynamics reduce refinement cost and accommodate changing payloads. TimeOpt optimizes traversal speed along the fixed path under sampled velocity, acceleration, jerk, and torque constraints, exploiting local spline support to solve banded Newton systems efficiently on the GPU. With a 3,kg payload, cuRoboV2-Fast achieves 4.4 ms mean planning time on RTX 5090, 14.7x faster than cuRoboV2. Our method on Jetson AGX Orin plans faster than cuRoboV1 + TOPPRA on RTX 5090. A stereo-camera-based deployment on YAM achieves 5.93 s mean completed pick-and-drop cycles, 34.6% shorter than cuRoboV2. Code (Apache 2.0): www.github.com/NVlabs/curobo , Project Page: www.research.nvidia.com/labs/lpr/curobov2-fast .
tldr: cuRoboV2-Fast presents a GPU-accelerated motion planner that significantly reduces planning latency and execution time for payload-aware, torque-limited trajectories, demonstrating faster planning on RTX 5090 and real-robot pick-and-drop speedups.
tldr_zh: cuRoboV2-Fast 提出了一种GPU加速的运动规划器，显著降低了负载感知、力矩受限轨迹规划的延迟和执行时间，在RTX 5090上实现更快的规划，并缩短了真实机器人拾取和放置周期时间。
summary_zh: 我们提出cuRoboV2-Fast，一种GPU加速的规划器，在保证无碰撞、负载感知和力矩受限的运动中，同时降低规划延迟和执行时间。B样条轨迹优化减少了所需迭代次数，而加速的机器人计算与可微逆动力学则降低了细化成本并适应变化的负载。TimeOpt在采样的速度、加速度、加加速度和力矩约束下优化沿固定路径的遍历速度，利用局部样条支持在GPU上高效求解带状牛顿方程组。在3千克负载下，cuRoboV2-Fast在RTX 5090上实现了4.4毫秒的平均规划时间，比cuRoboV2快14.7倍。我们的方法在Jetson AGX Orin上的规划速度快于RTX 5090上的cuRoboV1 + TOPPRA。基于立体相机的部署在YAM上实现了5.93秒的平均完成抓放周期，比cuRoboV2缩短34.6%。代码（Apache 2.0）：www.github.com/NVlabs/curobo，项目页面：www.research.nvidia.com/labs/lpr/curobov2-fast。

title: Reinforcement Learning Enables Scaling Generalist Robot Policy Improvement
summary: The introduction of generalist robot policies has enabled a single, large model to learn to perform a variety of tasks from a vast pre-training corpus. While these models often exhibit powerful zero-shot generalization capabilities, they typically require an adaptation phase to achieve sufficient performance in deployment. Iterated self-improvement via reinforcement learning (RL) has demonstrated promise in enabling this adaptation, yet such approaches have been largely explored in single-task settings - where the goal is to simply improve on a narrow deployment task - which lies in stark contrast to the multi-task capabilities of the base policy. In this work we ask whether generalist robot policies are capable of multi-task, generalist improvement in deployment - targeting many diverse tasks simultaneously - and what algorithmic recipe enables this. To answer this question, we first develop a set of structured evaluations to test generalist improvement capabilities, and systematically evaluate algorithmic and practical design choices regarding value estimation, policy extraction and resource allocation. We show that not only can generalist policies be improved online across diverse tasks, but that the right recipe can enable generalization and increase performance on tasks not considered during online training. We characterize when this generalization occurs and show that both the training task distribution and the use of value-based RL are critical. To the best of our knowledge, this is among the first evidence for online generalist improvement for robot foundation models.
tldr: This paper investigates whether generalist robot policies can be improved via multi-task reinforcement learning, proposing an algorithmic recipe that enables online improvement and generalization to unseen tasks. It provides evidence that value-based RL and training task distribution are critical for achieving online generalist improvement for robot foundation models.
tldr_zh: 本文探讨了通用机器人策略能否通过多任务强化学习进行改进，提出了一种算法方案，实现在线改进并泛化到未见任务。研究表明，基于价值的强化学习和训练任务分配对实现机器人基础模型的在线通用改进至关重要。
summary_zh: 引言：通用机器人策略的引入使得单一大型模型能够从大量预训练语料库中学习执行多种任务。尽管这些模型往往展现出强大的零样本泛化能力，但它们在部署中通常需要经过适应阶段才能达到足够的性能水平。通过强化学习进行的迭代自我改进已被证明能够促进这种适应，然而此类方法主要局限于单任务场景——目标是简单地在某个狭窄的部署任务上进行改进——这与基础策略的多任务能力形成了鲜明对比。在本研究中，我们探讨通用机器人策略是否具备多任务、通用性的部署改进能力——即同时针对多个多样化任务进行改进——以及何种算法配方能够实现这一目标。为了回答这一问题，我们首先开发了一套结构化评估方案来测试通用改进能力，并系统地评估了关于价值估计、策略提取和资源分配的算法及实践设计选择。我们不仅证明了通用策略能够在多样化任务上进行在线改进，还发现正确的配方能够促进泛化，并提升在线训练中未涉及任务的表现。我们刻画了这种泛化发生的情境，并表明训练任务分布以及基于价值的强化学习的使用均至关重要。据我们所知，这是机器人基础模型在线通用改进能力的首批证据之一。

title: VABAR: A Variational Automation Benchmark for Agentic Robotics
summary: For robots to operate reliably in commercial and industrial applications, they must persistently perform specific tasks with known variations in object shape and pose. We call this Variational Automation (VA) to differentiate these settings from fixed automation. Inspired by recent papers on Agentic Robotics, where pretrained LLM and VLM coding agents combine interpretable robot programming with the open-world adaptability of model free policies, we propose a general set of agentic robotics benchmark design criteria that includes accessibility, repeatability, diversity, relevance to agentic robotics and practical applications, physical realizability, resistance to benchmark saturation, and computational efficiency. We instantiate these principles in six manipulation task classes spanning industrial, medical, and infrastructure applications: tool sorting, tool hanging, gear meshing, syringe packing, cable insertion, and cable routing. We introduce the Variational Automation Benchmark for Agentic Robotics (VABAR), an open, easily replicable, simulation-based manipulation benchmark to systematically evaluating agentic robotics systems. Built fully on open-source tools, VABAR features detailed implementations using the Newton physics engine, standardized task variations, difficulty tiers, success metrics, and a library of 33 generalizable skills with human-authored programmatic reference solutions. We provide initial baseline evaluations using an open agentic manipulation harness, Graph-as-Policy (GaP), and Isaac Lab Arena.
tldr: VABAR is a simulation-based benchmark for agentic robotics manipulation, featuring six task classes, standardized variations, and baseline evaluations using agentic programming harnesses.
tldr_zh: VABAR 是一个基于仿真的智能体机器人操作基准，包含六类任务、标准化变体以及使用智能体编程框架的基线评估。
summary_zh:
摘要：
为使机器人在商业和工业应用中可靠运行，它们必须持续执行特定任务，同时应对物体形状和位姿的已知变化。我们将其称为“变分自动化”（Variational Automation, VA），以区别于固定自动化场景。受近期关于智能体机器人学（Agentic Robotics）研究的启发——该领域利用预训练的大语言模型（LLM）和视觉语言模型（VLM）编码智能体，将可解释的机器人编程与模型无关策略的开放世界适应性相结合——我们提出了一套通用的智能体机器人基准设计准则，包括可访问性、可重复性、多样性、与智能体机器人学及实际应用的相关性、物理可实现性、抗基准饱和性以及计算效率。我们将这些原则具体落实于六类涵盖工业、医疗和基础设施应用的操作任务中：工具分拣、工具悬挂、齿轮啮合、注射器包装、线缆插接和线缆布线。我们引入了面向智能体机器人学的变分自动化基准（VABAR），这是一个开放、易于复现、基于仿真的操作基准，用于系统性地评估智能体机器人系统。VABAR完全基于开源工具构建，采用Newton物理引擎提供详细实现，包含标准化的任务变体、难度等级、成功度量指标，以及一个包含33种可泛化技能并配有专家编写的程序化参考解决方案的技能库。我们使用开放的智能体操作框架Graph-as-Policy（GaP）和Isaac Lab Arena提供了初步的基线评估结果。

title: WAM-Sim0.1: World Anchored Memory Meets Online RL for Consistent and Realistic Driving Simulation
summary: Autoregressive driving world models systematically suffer from structural drift, identity drift, and quality decay over long rollout horizons due to transient conditioning signals that lack persistent state. We present WAM-Sim, a driving world model anchored by a persistent hierarchical memory and optimized via online flow-matching RL. WAM-Sim structures persistent context across three temporal and semantic scales: pose-aligned structural tokens encoding persistent road topology, read-only scene tokens supplying geolocated background appearance, and write-once instance tokens preserving individual traffic participant identities across occlusions and chunk boundaries. To restore visual sharpness and physical plausibility degraded by multi-scale conditioning, we introduce an online post-training framework that optimizes self-generated rollouts via flow-matching RL guided by hierarchy-aligned visual rewards and a vision-language model physical judge. The invariant memory empirically confines policy optimization within the anchored context, helping suppress semantic collapse and reward hacking, while online RL systematically enforces physical commonsense and fine-grained visual fidelity. On the nuScenes benchmark, WAM-Sim achieves a superior generation fidelity (FID=3.47, FVD=25.72) and strong downstream perception performance (24.16 mAP, 71.23 road mIoU). On minute-scale rollouts of self-collected data, WAM-Sim substantially mitigates structural and identity drift, preserving high scene similarity and subject identity coherence across extended horizons. Project page: https://fudan-generative-vision.github.io/WAM-Sim.
tldr: WAM-Sim introduces a driving world model with persistent hierarchical memory and online flow-matching RL to mitigate structural/identity drift and quality decay in long-horizon simulation, achieving state-of-the-art fidelity on nuScenes and stable minute-scale rollouts.
tldr_zh: WAM-Sim提出了一种具有持久分层记忆和在线流匹配强化学习的驾驶世界模型，有效缓解了长时程仿真中的结构/身份漂移和质量衰减，在nuSceens上实现了最先进的保真度，并保持分钟级rollout的稳定性。
summary_zh: 自回归驾驶世界模型在长程推演中，由于缺乏持久状态的瞬态条件信号，系统性地存在结构漂移、身份漂移和质量衰减问题。我们提出WAM-Sim，一种以持久分层记忆为锚定的驾驶世界模型，并通过在线流匹配强化学习进行优化。WAM-Sim在三个时间和语义尺度上构建持久上下文：姿态对齐的结构标记编码持久道路拓扑，只读场景标记提供地理定位的背景外观，以及一次写入的实例标记在遮挡和分块边界之间保持个体交通参与者的身份。为恢复因多尺度条件化而退化的视觉清晰度和物理合理性，我们引入一种在线后训练框架，该框架通过流匹配强化学习优化自生成推演，并使用与层级对齐的视觉奖励和视觉语言模型物理评判器进行引导。不变记忆凭经验将策略优化约束在锚定上下文中，有助于抑制语义崩溃和奖励攻击，同时在线强化学习系统性地强化物理常识和细粒度视觉保真度。在nuScenes基准测试中，WAM-Sim实现了优异的生成保真度（FID=3.47，FVD=25.72）和强下游感知性能（24.16 mAP，71.23道路mIoU）。在自采集数据的分钟级推演中，WAM-Sim显著减轻了结构和身份漂移，在扩展时域上保持了高场景相似性和主体身份一致性。项目页面：https://fudan-generative-vision.github.io/WAM-Sim。

title: SHORE: Stability-Hybrid On-Policy Reinforcement Learning for Online Bin Packing
summary: Online 3D bin packing with a processing buffer requires choosing which box to pack, its orientation, and its placement while keeping the stack stable under unknown future arrivals. A collapse ends the episode and forfeits the remaining volume. Existing methods use geometric rules or hard stability masks, limiting how risk can influence the joint choice of box, orientation, and placement. We propose Stability-Hybrid On-Policy Reinforcement Learning (SHORE), which combines a learned stability probability of a placement with an on-policy estimate of its return conditional on stability. A 3D U-Net learns stability from executed outcomes and simulated alternatives, revealing outcomes of actions underrepresented in early rollouts. A discrete on-policy actor--critic uses stability predictions in both its action values and policy prior, with gates that limit the effect of an untrained or changing model. In deployment, SHORE does not require additional search or simulation overhead. In Isaac Gym, SHORE reaches 73\% space utilization by 0.4M environment steps, while the same learner without stability modeling reaches that level at about 1M. On the expanded 60-box set, SHORE achieves 0.734 space utilization versus 0.588 for the GOPT state-of-the-art baseline, with a higher placement-failure frequency (1.03\% vs. 0.63\%), trading more risk for greater packed volume. The results show faster learning and higher utilization on the more demanding realistic box arrival set. Ablations suggest that simulated alternatives provide useful early supervision, while executed outcomes alone sustain later performance. We also demonstrate the method on a real robot to verify the simplicity of integrating the method to real bin packing pipelines.
tldr: SHORE introduces a stability-hybrid on-policy RL method for online 3D bin packing, using a learned stability probability and conditional return estimates to improve packing density and learning speed, validated in Isaac Gym and on a real robot.
tldr_zh: SHORE提出了一种用于在线3D装箱的稳定性混合在线强化学习方法，利用学习到的稳定性概率和条件回报估计来提高装箱密度和学习速度，并在Isaac Gym和真实机器人上进行了验证。
summary_zh: 在线三维装箱问题中引入处理缓冲区后，需要在未知未来到达货物的情况下，选择装入哪个箱子、确定其朝向及放置位置，同时保持堆叠稳定。一旦发生坍塌，该回合即告结束，并放弃剩余可利用空间。现有方法通常采用几何规则或硬性稳定掩码，这限制了风险对箱子选择、朝向及放置位置联合决策的影响程度。为此，我们提出了一种名为SHORE（Stability-Hybrid On-Policy Reinforcement Learning，稳定性混合同策略强化学习）的方法，它将所学到的放置稳定性概率与基于稳定性的条件回报的同策略估计相结合。我们利用三维U-Net网络从实际执行结果和模拟替代方案中学习稳定性，从而揭示早期推演中代表性不足动作的结果。离散同策略Actor-Critic模型在动作价值和策略先验中均使用稳定性预测，并设置门控机制以限制未训练或变化模型的影响。部署时，SHORE无需额外的搜索或模拟开销。在Isaac Gym环境中，SHORE在40万环境步时即达到73%的空间利用率，而同等条件下未引入稳定性建模的学习器约在100万步时才达到该水平。在扩展至60箱的测试集上，SHORE取得了0.734的空间利用率，优于当前最优基线GOPT的0.588，同时其放置失败频率略高（1.03%对比0.63%），即以更高的风险换取更大的装箱体积。实验结果表明，在更具挑战性的真实箱体到达序列上，SHORE实现了更快的收敛速度和更高的利用率。消融研究进一步表明，模拟替代方案在训练初期提供了有效的监督信号，而实际执行结果则能维持后期性能。我们还在真实机器人上验证了该方法的可行性，证明了其易于集成到实际装箱流水线中的简便性。

title: Aligning Policy Encoders with a Shape Teacher
summary: 3D-aware representations can improve robotic manipulation by providing geometric information that is robust to changes in viewpoint, object position, and occlusion. However, using 3D inputs at deployment requires additional sensing and processing, making image-based policies more practical. We ask whether an image-based policy can acquire 3D shape information during training while retaining a purely image-based interface at deployment. We propose shape-teacher alignment, a training-time mechanism that uses a pretrained 3D shape representation as an alignment target for an image-based policy encoder. Specifically, we use Point-MAE features from individual objects as targets for corresponding image patches, transferring geometric structure to the policy without changing its deployment inputs or architecture. On LIBERO, shape-teacher alignment produces image representations that are more structured around object shape and corresponding parts, while substantially accelerating policy convergence and improving success rates. For pretrained policies, convergence is accelerated by 4.7x and 5.6x on the Object and Spatial suites, respectively, without requiring the shape teacher or depth input at deployment.
tldr: This paper introduces shape-teacher alignment, a training-time method that transfers 3D shape knowledge from Point-MAE to image-based robot policies, accelerating convergence and improving success rates on LIBERO without requiring 3D inputs at deployment.
tldr_zh: 本文提出形状教师对齐方法，在训练时将Point-MAE的3D形状知识迁移到基于图像的机器人策略中，在LIBERO上加速收敛并提高成功率，且部署时无需3D输入。
summary_zh: 三维感知表示能够通过提供对视角变化、物体位置变化以及遮挡具有鲁棒性的几何信息，从而提升机器人操作性能。然而，在部署阶段使用三维输入需要额外的感知与处理成本，这使得基于图像的策略更具实用性。我们探究是否可以在训练过程中使基于图像的策略获取三维形状信息，同时保持部署阶段纯粹基于图像的接口。为此，我们提出形状教师对齐机制，这是一种训练阶段的策略，利用预训练的三维形状表示作为图像策略编码器的对齐目标。具体而言，我们使用来自单个物体的Point-MAE特征作为对应图像块的目标，从而在不改变策略部署输入或架构的前提下，将几何结构迁移至策略中。在LIBERO基准上，形状教师对齐使图像表示围绕物体形状及其对应部件形成更有序的结构，同时显著加速策略收敛并提升成功率。对于预训练策略，在Object套件和Spatial套件上收敛速度分别提升4.7倍和5.6倍，且部署时无需形状教师或深度输入。

title: AffordJEV: Affordance Grounding by Confirming Candidate Regions
summary: Affordance grounding asks which visible part of an object performs a requested operation, a basic capability for embodied manipulation and human--robot interaction. Most existing methods follow a System Two paradigm: a multimodal language model first writes a chain of thought and then turns its conclusion into a box or points for a segmenter. This incurs considerable inference cost, gives the semantic decision little direct control over the extent of the final region, and makes mistakes hard to correct. Yet locating an affordance is essentially a perceptual judgment that need not be argued out in words. We therefore propose, in which frozen segmenters propose candidate regions and a System One model decides directly which of them perform the operation, generating no text and reading each decision from a single forward pass. Our contributions are twofold. (1) An inference framework that confirms candidate regions level by level, from object to part to sub-part, with evidence passed between the levels in both directions so that the levels correct one another. (2) A System One model trained for this framework: existing System One models are built for general-purpose decisions, judge one candidate per request and are ill-suited to the framework's region questions, so ours learns directly from the requests the framework itself produces and judges all candidates of a level at once. Trained only on InstructPart and evaluated with definition-aligned operation words, outperforms chain-of-thought methods in domain and in zero-shot transfer to UMD and IIT-AFF, is better overall than existing System One models run in the same framework, and needs fewer judge requests. To our knowledge, is the first approach to bring System One models to affordance grounding.
tldr: AffordJEV introduces a System One inference framework for affordance grounding, where frozen segmenters propose candidate regions and a trained model directly confirms which candidates afford the requested operation, eliminating chain-of-thought text generation. It improves accuracy and efficiency over System Two methods across multiple datasets.
tldr_zh: AffordJEV 提出了一种用于可供性定位的 System One 推理框架，由冻结的分割器提出候选区域，并由训练好的模型直接确认哪些候选区域能实现请求的操作，从而无需生成思维链文本，在多个数据集上比 System Two 方法更准确高效。
summary_zh: 功能可供性定位是指确定物体上哪个可见部分能够执行所请求的操作，这是具身操作和人机交互中的一项基本能力。现有方法大多遵循System Two范式：多模态语言模型首先生成思维链，然后将其结论转化为分割器的边界框或点。这种方式带来了相当大的推理成本，使得语义决策难以直接控制最终区域的范围，并且错误难以纠正。然而，定位可供性本质上是一种感知判断，无需用语言进行论证。因此，我们提出了一种方法，其中冻结的分割器提出候选区域，System One模型直接判断哪些区域执行该操作，不生成任何文本，并通过单次前向传播读取每个决策。我们的贡献有两方面。（1）一种推理框架，从对象到部件再到子部件，逐级确认候选区域，并在各级之间双向传递证据，使各级相互纠正。（2）针对该框架训练的System One模型：现有的System One模型是为通用决策而构建的，每次请求仅判断一个候选，不适合该框架的区域问题，因此我们的模型直接学习框架自身产生的请求，并同时判断一个层级的所有候选。仅在InstructPart上训练，并使用与定义对齐的操作词进行评估，该方法在领域内以及向UMD和IIT-AFF的零样本迁移中优于思维链方法，在同一框架下运行时总体上优于现有System One模型，并且需要的判断请求更少。据我们所知，这是首次将System One模型引入功能可供性定位的方法。

title: Seeing Beyond the Next Step: World-Model-Guided Human-Like Navigation in Multi-Agent Scenes
summary: Selecting a next motion in a populated scene is not just a matter of avoiding what is currently in the way: an action can be locally feasible yet drift onto the road instead of the crosswalk, cut into a stream of crossing pedestrians, or bottleneck a narrow passage. These failure modes are invisible from the current state alone, and acting on them requires reasoning about what each candidate action will cause. World models offer exactly this, namely action-conditioned predictions of the future, but rolling them out at every decision step is a cost deployable navigation systems cannot pay, and the field has largely traded foresight for speed. We argue this is a false dichotomy. The natural place for a world model in human-aware navigation is at training time, as a preference oracle that distills foresight into a fast policy, rather than at inference time, as an online planner. We pair a discrete visual action prior with two task-aligned world models, one for nearby social dynamics and one for future scene semantics, that score candidate actions by their predicted consequences and refine the policy through group-relative preference distillation. At deployment, both world models are removed and the policy acts in a single forward pass. Across five held-out evaluation scenarios, this yields navigation that is simultaneously safer, more socially and group-coherent, and more goal-directed than strong reactive and learned baselines, with naive observers rating the resulting motion as more human-like. Taken together, our findings point to a different approach for bringing world-model foresight into deployable agents: not accelerating rollouts, but amortizing them into the policy so that the cost of looking ahead is confined to training. Project page: https://seoneun.github.io/-NeurIPS-2026-Seeing-Beyond-the-Next-Step/
tldr: The paper proposes using world models at training time as preference oracles to distill foresight into a fast, single-pass navigation policy, achieving more human-like and safer navigation in multi-agent scenes without online rollouts.
tldr_zh: 本文提出在训练时使用世界模型作为偏好预言机，将远见蒸馏到快速单步导航策略中，在无需在线推演的情况下实现更安全、更类人的多智能体场景导航。
summary_zh: 在人群密集的场景中选择下一步动作，不仅仅是避开当前障碍的问题：一个动作在局部上或许是可行的，却可能漂移离开人行横道而进入车道、切入横穿而过的行人流，或在狭窄通道造成瓶颈。这些失效模式仅从当前状态是无法察觉的，而要应对它们，需要对每个候选动作将引发的后果进行推理。世界模型恰恰提供了这种能力，即基于动作的未来状态条件预测，但在每个决策步骤中进行 rollout 的成本是实际部署的导航系统无法承受的，因此该领域在很大程度上以速度换取了前瞻性。我们认为这是一种错误的二分法。在人机共融导航中，世界模型的天然位置是在训练阶段，作为将前瞻能力蒸馏进快速策略的偏好裁判，而非在推理阶段充当在线规划器。我们将离散视觉动作先验与两个面向任务对齐的世界模型相结合——一个负责邻近社会动力学，另一个负责未来场景语义——通过预测的后果对候选动作进行评分，并通过群体相对偏好蒸馏来优化策略。部署时，两个世界模型均被移除，策略只需一次前向传播即可执行。在五个留出评估场景中，该方法相比强反应式基线和学习基线，同时实现了更安全、更具社会性与群体一致性、更目标导向的导航效果，且未经过训练的评估者认为其运动更接近人类行为。综合来看，我们的研究指向了一种将世界模型前瞻能力引入可部署智能体的不同路径：并非加速 rollout，而是将其摊销进策略之中，使前瞻的成本仅存在于训练阶段。项目主页：https://seoneun.github.io/-NeurIPS-2026-Seeing-Beyond-the-Next-Step/

title: Dual-Arm Tabletop Rearrangement with Movable Stacking and Gap-Aware Push Transfers
summary: Object rearrangement in cluttered tabletop scenes is challenging, especially in wide workspaces where dual-arm systems improve coverage and efficiency. Limited free space often necessitates buffering, while objects near or across the shared reachability region of the manipulators must be transferred under careful coordination to avoid inter-arm collisions. Conventional inter-arm transfer typically relies on a fixed handoff configuration, which constrains where and how objects are exchanged, enforces spatiotemporal synchronization of the arms, and reduces flexibility in dense layouts. This paper presents a dual-arm rearrangement framework that combines movable stacking with Gap-Aware Push Transfer for asynchronous cross-boundary exchange. The method scans the shared boundary to identify collision-free transfer gaps, places an object near a selected crossing point, and then pushes it into the receiving workspace without requiring simultaneous interaction between the two arms. A joint Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS)-based planner coordinates both manipulators while reasoning over buffering and transfer decisions, and execution cost is used after planning to assess the resulting plan. Experiments show that the proposed method shortens joint execution sequences and becomes increasingly advantageous over a fixed handoff baseline as scene density increases, achieving lower execution cost in denser scenes while remaining competitive in lighter ones.
tldr: This paper presents a dual-arm tabletop rearrangement framework using movable stacking and a gap-aware push transfer strategy to enable asynchronous inter-arm object exchange, with a joint MCTS-based planner minimizing execution cost, showing advantages in dense scenes.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种双臂桌面重排框架，利用可移动堆叠和间隙感知推传策略实现异步跨臂物体交换，并通过联合MCTS规划器降低执行成本，在密集场景中优于固定交接基线。
summary_zh: 在杂乱桌面场景中的物体重排具有挑战性，尤其是在广域工作空间中，双臂系统可提升覆盖范围和效率。有限的空闲空间通常需要缓冲操作，而位于机械臂共享可达区域附近或跨越该区域的物体必须在精细协调下进行交接，以避免机械臂间碰撞。传统的臂间交接通常依赖固定的交接构型，这限制了物体交换的位置和方式，强制双臂时空同步，并降低了在密集布局中的灵活性。本文提出了一种双臂重排框架，结合可移动堆叠与间隙感知推送交接，实现异步跨边界物体交换。该方法扫描共享边界以识别无碰撞交接间隙，将物体放置在选定的穿越点附近，然后将其推入接收工作空间，无需两臂同时交互。基于联合蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）的规划器协调两只机械臂，同时对缓冲与交接决策进行推理，并在规划后使用执行代价评估所生成的方案。实验表明，所提方法缩短了联合执行序列，且随着场景密度增加，相较于固定交接基线具有越来越明显的优势，在较密集场景中实现更低执行代价，同时在较稀疏场景中保持竞争力。

title: PhySA: Decoupling Aesthetic and Physical Rewards for Humanoid Locomotion
summary: Humanoid locomotion policies trained without an explicit smoothness objective tend to produce jerky, high-energy gaits that stress actuators. Vision-language models (VLMs) offer an appealing reward source: given a rendered rollout, a VLM returns an aesthetic quality score on [0,10] without task-specific feature engineering. We find, however, that aesthetic preference and physical smoothness point in opposite directions: across four production VLMs, clips with higher joint acceleration receive higher aesthetic scores (mean Pearson r=+0.66). We study PhySA (Physical Smoothness and Aesthetics), which keeps the two on separate, independently removable reward channels: a sparse, asynchronous VLM score and a phase-triggered correction channel that adjusts physical penalty weights from simulator state. Ablations attribute the smoothness gain to the correction channel. On MuJoCo Humanoid-v5 at 2.6M steps, PhySA lowers joint acceleration by 26 to 32% relative to vanilla PPO, Text2Reward, and Eureka (three seeds), at the cost of shorter episodes. In a single extended run it lowers joint acceleration by 59.5% relative to Prompt2Policy, while a three-seed replication shows a smaller, non-significant reduction (7.2%). The gain does not transfer to IsaacLab or the Unitree G1, even after rescaling the smoothness term.
tldr: PhySA decouples aesthetic VLM rewards from physics-based smoothness penalties to reduce joint acceleration in humanoid locomotion, showing improvements in MuJoCo but limited transfer.
tldr_zh: PhySA将美学VLM奖励与基于物理的平滑惩罚分离，以减少人形机器人运动中的关节加速度，在MuJoCo中有所改善但迁移有限。
summary_zh: 人体动作控制策略若缺少显式的平滑性目标，往往会产生急促、高能耗的步态，对执行器造成较大压力。视觉-语言模型（VLMs）提供了一种颇具吸引力的奖励来源：给定一段渲染出的动作序列，VLM无需针对特定任务的特征工程，即可返回一个[0,10]区间内的美学质量评分。然而，我们发现美学偏好与物理平滑性指向相反方向：在四种主流VLM中，关节加速度更高的片段获得了更高的美学评分（平均Pearson相关系数r=+0.66）。我们研究了PhySA（物理平滑性与美学）方法，该方法将两者保持在独立且可分别移除的奖励通道上：一个稀疏、异步的VLM评分通道和一个由相位触发的校正通道，后者根据模拟器状态调整物理惩罚权重。消融实验将平滑性提升归因于校正通道。在MuJoCo Humanoid-v5上，经过260万步训练，与标准PPO、Text2Reward和Eureka相比（三种随机种子），PhySA将关节加速度降低了26%至32%，但代价是回合长度缩短。在单次扩展运行中，相对于Prompt2Policy，PhySA将关节加速度降低了59.5%；而三次种子重复实验则显示出较小且不显著的降幅（7.2%）。该提升效果未迁移至IsaacLab或Unitree G1，即便重新调整平滑项的权重系数亦然。

title: Energy-Aware Open-Vocabulary Detection Scheduling for Low-Power Robotic Autonomy
summary: Open-vocabulary object detection (OVD) lets robots search for run-time object queries, but fixed-rate inference spends embedded compute on low-value frames during idle motion, map revisits, or stable viewpoints. This paper presents an energy-aware OVD scheduler for low-power mobile robots. The scheduler uses odometry, map change, and detector confidence to switch among low-, mid-, and high-power YOLO-World-S modes on a Jetson Orin Nano. We evaluate the energy-quality trade-off on an AgileX LIMO using 40 real navigation trials: two target objects, five placements per target-policy pair, and four perception policies. Across bottle and cup trials, the scheduler records 8/10 mission success compared with 7/10 for each fixed-rate baseline, while reducing mean Jetson input power (a Jetson-side power-draw metric) by 5.2% relative to an 8 Hz high-rate baseline and lowering achieved OVD call rate by 34.0%.
